# Design brief (read-only, write ONE file) — language mirroring, English KG, text model chain, streaming (D-104). Do NOT edit code.
Read ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/spec.md, docs/DECISIONS.md D-100..D-104, and the code paths: chat turn (apps/api/src/chat.ts, anonymous.ts, voice.ts), engine graph (packages/engine/src: graph, prompts, guards/crisis.ts, any fact/profile extraction, student-graph), providers (packages/providers/src/index.ts: Gemini, Ollama, failover chain), db student KG/profile writes (packages/db). Answer with file:line evidence:
1. Reply language today: how is the reply language chosen? What changes so the bot replies in whatever language/script the student uses (any language, incl. Hinglish in Latin vs Devanagari), with the crisis message also in that language where we have a vetted translation and English+Hindi otherwise?
2. Student KG: where are facts extracted and stored, in what language? Design: original message stored as written; KG facts written in English directly by the extraction call (no separate translation call). Schema impact, migration of existing non-English facts (if any), and prompt change.
3. Model chain: where is the provider chosen and is there a failover chain already? Design glm-5.3-flash -> deepseek-v4.1-flash -> (later) Gemini Flash-Lite for the text calls: which calls, failover triggers (timeout, 5xx, malformed JSON — GLM returned one malformed reply in the paid run), budget/ledger and token tracking per hop, and what stays on Gemini (Live voice).
4. Streaming: does the API/web support streamed replies today (SSE, chunked)? Design first-token streaming for text chat, keeping: crisis guard on the input before any model call, output guards on the full reply (how to guard a streamed reply: buffer-then-release per sentence, or stream then retract?), persistence after completion, A8 latency measured as first token.
5. Split into build units by file ownership (which can run in parallel, which are serial and why), each with acceptance criteria and tier, and rough size.
Write the design to qa/evidence/p1-briefs/p1-lang-kg-design-result.md (plain language summary first, then detail) and commit only that file. Final message: the 10-line summary and the unit list.
